0022600217.text: The Wizards (4-7, 2-5 on the road, four straight losses) are 10th in the East and visit the Pacers (3-8, 0-5 at home, two straight losses), who sit 12th in the East. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Wizards won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 131-118 win in Washington on February 20.
